limitations: One bounded local HTTP service trial, not a general reliability or production-readiness guarantee.
The 44 scenarios include three preserved baseline scenarios; these are not 44 plus three.
Codex reviewed the three approval gates under user authorization.
Temporary loopback services are stopped after checks; no persistent or cloud deployment.
Normal Content-Length framing only; adversarial framing, request size limits, concurrency and production hardening were not part of this trial.
Tokens are framework-reported, not billed cost; elapsed time includes review waits.
Generated source remains in run artifacts; baseline repository was not promoted or published.
